App sounds: auditions

Listen with headphones, and to the phone-speaker and Bluetooth previews too: players hear these all three ways. Each variant has the command that picks it; run it from the repo root. A pick writes the file into content/app/ and updates app.json.

Picked now

  • Sting: jessica-a1 over cinematic-1
  • Earcons: marimba

Intro sting

A voice over a logo bed, as content/app/sting.m4a would be: the bed ducks under the voice and fades out over its last 0.4 s; the mix is levelled to -16 LUFS with peaks at most -1.5 dBFS (AAC stereo). The phone-speaker preview is the same sting folded to mono with nothing under 500 Hz. Voice over bed is how far the voice stands above the ducked bed while it speaks (more is clearer); mono fold is what a one-speaker phone loses beyond the usual 3 dB (over 2 dB is flagged).

jessica-a1: “Epic Audio Games!”

Jessica, as she hosts the games; stability 0.5, style 0.15, seed 1.

Earcons

The sounds of the microphone opening and closing, and of a pack installed. The in-game demo plays the end of a question (“Welcome back Pinocchio! Want to play Battle or Challenge mode?”), the listening sound, 1.2 s for an answer, then the stopped sound; the Bluetooth demo is the same through a call-quality headset link (300 to 3400 Hz). The listening sound must be easy to hear over the story and never sound like a word. Above 3.4 kHz is how much of a sound such a link loses.
